title: Protocol for analysis of G2/M DNA synthesis in human cells
protocol: Seed cells at 20% confluence into a 150 mm dish when they are fully confluent but not overconfluent.
Grow cells in the incubator for around 20 hours.
Remove the media from the 150 mm dish on day 2–3.
Wash the cells once with 10 mL of prewarmed PBS.
Add 20 mL of serum starvation media (DMEM supplemented with 0.2% FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, and 50 U/mL penicillin/streptomycin) to the dish.
Keep the cells in the incubator for 26 hours.
Remove starvation media from cells.
Add 20 mL of prewarmed culture media to a 150 mm dish.
Wash cells four times with prewarmed PBS for 5 minutes.
Remove the media containing Ro-3306 from the 150 mm dish.
Pulse cells with 25 μM EdU and 50 μM BrdU in fresh prewarmed media for 30 min.
Wash cells once with ice-cold PBS.
Incubate the cells with 4 mL trypsin for 10 min in 5% CO2 at 37°C.
Mix the trypsin-treated cells with 10 mL ice-cold regular DMEM to inactivate trypsin.
Centrifuge the cells at 900 × g, 4°C for 3 min.
Wash cells once with 10 mL ice-cold PBS followed by centrifugation at 900 × g, 4°C for 3 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL ice-cold PBS and transfer to a 1.5 mL Low DNA Binding tube.
Centrifuge the resuspended cells at 900 × g, 4°C for 3 min.
Fix cells by gently resuspending cell pellet in 1 mL freshly made PTEMF buffer for 20 min at 15°C–30°C.
Pellet fixed cells by centrifugation at 900 × g, 4°C for 3 min and discard the supernatant.
Wash fixed cells twice with 1 mL of ice-cold PBS, keeping at 15°C–30°C for 5 min each time followed by centrifugation at 1000 × g, 4°C for 3 min.
Store the cells in 1 mL ice-cold PBS at 4°C until use.
Remove supernatant from fixed cells after centrifugation at 1000 × g, 4°C for 3 min.
Resuspend the pellet with 600 μL 10% FBS/PBS by gently pipetting.
Incubate cells in 10% FBS/PBS for 1 h at 15°C–30°C.
Remove the 10% FBS/PBS from cells by centrifugation at 1000 × g at 15–30°C for 3 min.
Resuspend cells with 600 μL 1:2000 diluted rabbit monoclonal anti-Phospho-Histone H3 (pS10-H3) in 1% FBS/PBS.
Wash cells three times with 800 μL of 1% FBS/PBS for 5 minutes.
Pellet cells each time by centrifugation at 1000 × g at 15°C–30°C for 3 minutes.
Incubate the cells with 600 μL of 1:1000 diluted Alexa Fluor488-conjugated goat anti-rabbit antibody in 1% FBS/PBS in the dark, for 1 hour at 15°C–30°C.
Wash cells three times with 800 μL of 1% FBS/PBS for 5 minutes.
Pellet cells each time by centrifugation at 1000 × g at 15°C–30°C for 3 minutes.
Gently resuspend the cells in 800 μL of 1% FBS/PBS.
Aliquot 100 μL of cells to a new DNA Low Binding tube for EdU Click-iT reaction.
Remove the remaining 100 μL of 1% FBS/PBS from cells by centrifugation at 1000 × g at 15°C–30°C for 3 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet with 250 μL of reaction buffer by gently pipetting and incubate at 15°C–30°C in the dark for 30 minutes.
Quickly wash the cells with 1 mL Rinse buffer from the Click-iT Kit by centrifugation at 1000 × g at 15°C–30°C for 3 minutes.
Remove most of Rinse buffer and gently resuspend the pellet in 500 μL PBS containing 0.1 mg/mL RNase A and 0.5 μL Vybrant DyeCycle Violet Stain.
Remove the remaining 700 μL 1% FBS/PBS from cells by centrifugation at 1000 × g at 15°C–30°C for 3 min.
Gently resuspend the pellet in 700 μL PBS containing 0.1 mg/mL RNase A and 0.7 μL Vybrant DyeCycle Violet Stain (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Transfer the cells to one 5 mL FACS tube for sorting according to DNA content and positive pS10-H3 signal.
Store immunostained cells in PBS at 4°C, in the dark, for up to several days before cell sorting.
Sort cells using a BD FACSAria cell sorter machine (Beckton Dickinson).
Use samples A-D to determine signal intensities of cells positive and negative for pS10-H3 and in G2/M by DNA content.
Set gating specifically to select cells positive for both pS10-H3 and G2/M DNA content.
Sort Sample F based on the established gating parameters.
Perform sorting at a temperature range of 15°C–30°C.
Collect sorted cells in a 5 mL FACS tube containing 2 mL of 10% FBS/PBS.
Acquire control samples sequentially to determine signal intensities for each signal and allow color compensation.
Prepare Sample A with half of fixed asynchronous cells treated with 0.1 mg/mL RNase A as a no dye control.
Treat cells in Sample B with 0.1 mg/mL RNase A and stain only with 5 μM Vybrant DyeCycle Violet Stain to measure violet signal intensity according to DNA content.

Prepare Sample C by treating around half of fixed asynchronous cells grown in one dish only with 0.1 mg/mL RNase A in 500 μL PBS, used for measuring 594 intensity signals in cells that have incorporated EdU and perform DNA synthesis.
Immunostain a quarter of fixed synchronous cells grown in one 150 mm dish with pS10-H3 after treatment with 0.1 mg/mL RNase A.
Compensate color using single control samples.
Acquire Sample E to determine the frequency of G2/M cells performing DNA synthesis and ensure correct gating strategy for pS10-H3 positive cells.
Acquire Sample F from cells labeled for pS10-H3 and DNA content, sorting according to positivity to pS10-H3 and G2 DNA content.
Purify genomic DNA from G2/M cells collected after sorting (around 30,000 cells).
Centrifuge cells in a 5 mL FACS tube at 2800 × g for 10 minutes at 15°C–30°C to pellet the cells.
Remove most of the supernatant with around 1 mL remaining to avoid disrupting the pellets.
Transfer the cell pellet gently to a 1.5 mL Low DNA Binding tube using a 1 mL tip.
Centrifuge the cells in the 1.5 mL tube at maximum speed for 3 minutes at 15°C–30°C.
Remove most of the supernatant, leaving around 30 μL to avoid disrupting the pellets.
Add 200 μL TE to the 1.5 mL Low DNA Binding tube containing the cells.
Sonicate the cells using VCX130 with 30% Amp, 5 cycles of 15 seconds on and 10 seconds off, for a total pulsing on time of 1 minute 15 seconds.
Spin the cells for 10 seconds at maximum speed of the centrifuge at 15°C to 30°C in a 1.5 mL Low DNA Binding tube.
Incubate the cells at 65°C for 16 to 20 hours to reverse-crosslink.
Add 0.7 mg/mL proteinase K and incubate at 55°C for 3 hours.
Spin the cells for 10 seconds at maximum speed of the centrifuge at 15°C to 30°C.
Purify the DNA using DNA Clean & Concentrator-5.
Elute twice by adding 10 μL EB (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5).
Quantify the purified dsDNA using Qubit 3.0 Fluorometer.
Keep the purified DNA at −20°C until further use.
Aliquot 10 μL Dynabeads Protein A into a 1.5 mL Low DNA Binding tube.
Wash beads twice with 1 mL of 0.5% BSA/PBS/0.1% Tween 20.
Remove the washed solution by spinning the tube at 400 × g for 1 min at 15°C–30°C.
Place the tube on a magnet until the solution is clear (~1 min).
Mix beads with 200 μL of anti-BrdU antibody (Sigma-Aldrich) diluted 1:150 in 0.5% BSA/PBS/0.1% Tween 20.
Incubate at 4°C for 16–20 h with rotation.
Wash beads twice as in the previous washing steps.
After washes, add 10 μL of 0.5% BSA/PBS/0.1% Tween 20 to the beads and keep at 4°C until use.
Dilute purified DNA to a final volume of 200 μL with TE.
Denature DNA at 100°C for 10 min.
Immediately place the denatured DNA on ice for 5 min.
Aliquot 10 μL of the denatured DNA into a new 1.5 mL Low DNA Binding tube as Input for DNA library construction and store at −20°C until use.
Mix the beads with the remaining 190 μL of denatured DNA and 200 μL of blocking solution (2% BSA, 2× PBS, 0.2% Tween 20).
Incubate at 4°C for 16–20 h with rotation.
Wash BrdU-labeled DNA bound to beads twice with 1 mL of lysis buffer 1.
Wash BrdU-labeled DNA bound to beads twice with 1 mL of lysis buffer 2.
Wash BrdU-labeled DNA bound to beads twice with 1 mL of wash buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 1 mL of TE and centrifuge for 3 min at 900 × g at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant completely before resuspending the beads in 50 μl elution buffer.
Incubate the resuspended beads at 65°C for 10 min.
Mix the eluted DNA with 50 μL TE and 2.5 μL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL).
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 1 hour.
Thaw the Input DNA that had been stored at −20°C.
Mix thawed Input DNA with 40 μl TE.
Purify both single-stranded IP and Input DNA by DNA Clean & Concentrator-5 (Zymo Research).
Elute purified DNA twice with 7 μL nuclease-free water.
Reconstitute single-stranded BrdU-labeled DNA and Input DNA to double-stranded DNA using Random Primed DNA Labeling Kit.
Purify the double-stranded DNA by DNA Clean & Concentrator-5.
Elute purified DNA once with 7 μl EB (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5).
Store purified DNA at −20°C until further use.
Quantify DNA using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit on a Qubit 3.0 Fluorometer.
Take 250 pg of random-primed BrdU-DNA to prepare Illumina sequencing libraries according to the QIAseq Ultralow Input Library Kit protocol.
Clean up indexed libraries and quantify them.
Normalize and pool indexed libraries.
Sequence pooled libraries on the Illumina NextSeq 500 system with a High Output Kit v2.5 (75 cycles) in a single lane on a single-end run.
